Seven comments

Tom Doherty’s reel

This is Liz Carroll’s setting from what I’ve gathered. ABC source:
http://abcnotation.com/tunePage?a=trillian.mit.edu/~jc/music/abc/Ireland/reel/TomDohertysR_D/0000

Also, you can hear a bit of it at the end of the preview here:

http://www.amazon.com/gp/search?ie=UTF8&keywords=Liz+Carroll+-+Cuz+Teahan%27s%2FTom+Doherty%27s%2FJohnny+McGreevy%27s+Reels&tag=lastfmmp3-20&index=digital-music&linkCode=ur2&camp=1789&creative=9325

But Martin Hayes plays a different setting in B minor. Last tune:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=96bKIE37gwQ

↳ Posted by Whiddler on March 13th, 2011.

Martin playing it at the end of this video too:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2uGXNxndfrs

Now I’m never going to get it out of my head. :-)

↳ Posted by Whiddler on March 13th, 2011.
